frequency_question: How often does a congressional resolution of disapproval pass both chambers and take effect against a submitted nuclear cooperation agreement?
membership_rule: Includes all formal executive submissions of Section 123 nuclear cooperation agreements subject to the 90-day continuous session review period; excludes informal consultations or agreements not formally notified.
provenance_note: claims 30 cases from only 5 named (6.0x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 30+ named or categorized historical submissions; exact count of minor amendments exceeds 40, none of which were blocked by joint resolution.
known_gaps: Some minor technical amendments pass without formal congressional debate or recorded votes.
skeleton: Decades of nuclear cooperation agreements submitted under Section 123 of the Atomic Energy Act, categorized by formal review cycles.
multiplier: Approximately 30+ major agreements submitted historically, divided into eras of congressional oversight.
validity_reason: Statutory review procedures under the Atomic Energy Act remain stable across administrations.
